Degree requirement map

0 of 0

Rules that change course choices

  • Two fields by end of year 2. Missing the deadline triggers probation and a one-year extension; all fields must be complete by end of year 3.
  • Field GPA route: take the prescribed sequence in one academic year for quality grades and average at least 3.0. A course cannot count toward both fields.
  • Distribution: three courses outside both fields, each C− or better. Outside-department courses need DGS permission.
  • Core exams: three components after year 1; failed components may be retaken once. A second failure means dismissal.
  • Research paper: due by end of summer after year 3; failure to finish by beginning of Spring year 4 leads to withdrawal.
  • Teaching: five MTE points in years 2–5; grading can supply at most two total points.
  • Time to degree: dissertation defense by end of year 6; a seventh year requires an approved extenuating-circumstances petition.

Source: official 2025–26 Graduate Program Guidebook. Confirm policy changes for 2026–27 with Graduate Student Affairs.
